inv.desc_en:
REF: 7936739

Local with C1 license for sale in the heart of Barcelona!

Unique opportunity to start a business in one of the most vibrant areas of the Raval, in the heart of Barcelona. This 84 m² commercial premises has a privileged location on one of the busiest streets in the neighborhood, with a constant flow of pedestrians and tourists, which guarantees excellent visibility and exposure.

Main features:

Surface: 84 m²
Capacity: 30 people
C1 license: Perfect for hospitality businesses without a kitchen (bars, cafes, etc. )
2 fully equipped toilets
2 arcade machines with a current contract for 2 years
Loyal clientele, ready to continue supporting the business
Constant passing area, ideal for attracting new customers
Transfer €86,000 and Monthly rent €1,800
This is the perfect place for those who want to invest in a business with growth potential in one of the most dynamic and multicultural neighborhoods in Barcelona.

Don't miss the opportunity to be part of the success in this strategic location of the Raval!

For more information or to arrange a visit, do not hesitate to contact us at the Inmoolaya Real Estate agency.
